data.gender_notes: Hewett is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'hīwet' meaning 'bright, intellectual'. The name Hewett has been used in English-speaking countries since the Middle Ages. The name Hewett carries the meaning “Bright, intellectual” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hewett usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, intellectual and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of wisdom and understanding.
data.etymology: Hewett belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, intellectual.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hewett total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
